fsm_states_sensor_tx.name: POWER_UP
fsm_states_sensor_tx.description: Sensor powers up from the two-wire current loop supplied by the ECU; quiescent supply current established.

fsm_states_sensor_tx.name: IDLE
fsm_states_sensor_tx.description: Sensor idle. In synchronous mode it waits for the ECU sync pulse; in asynchronous mode it runs its own transmit timer.

fsm_states_sensor_tx.name: WAIT_SLOT
fsm_states_sensor_tx.description: Synchronous mode: after the sync pulse, wait until the sensor's assigned time slot.

fsm_states_sensor_tx.name: TX_START
fsm_states_sensor_tx.description: Drive the telegram start condition (start bits) by current modulation.

fsm_states_sensor_tx.name: TX_DATA
fsm_states_sensor_tx.description: Transmit the Manchester-coded data bits (and optional region/status bits) as +-26 mA current pulses.

fsm_states_sensor_tx.name: TX_CRC
fsm_states_sensor_tx.description: Transmit the error-check field (2-bit/3-bit CRC or parity) and end the telegram.

fsm_states_ecu_rx.name: RX_IDLE
fsm_states_ecu_rx.description: ECU powers the loop and monitors the loop current.

fsm_states_ecu_rx.name: SYNC_EMIT
fsm_states_ecu_rx.description: Synchronous mode: ECU emits the sync pulse (voltage pulse on the supply) to trigger the sensors.

fsm_states_ecu_rx.name: RX_SLOT
fsm_states_ecu_rx.description: ECU samples each time slot for a sensor telegram (synchronous mode).

fsm_states_ecu_rx.name: RX_DECODE
fsm_states_ecu_rx.description: Manchester-decode the modulated current pulses into a telegram.

fsm_states_ecu_rx.name: RX_CHECK
fsm_states_ecu_rx.description: Verify the telegram CRC/parity; accept on pass, discard on fail.

fsm_hints.trigger: Synchronous mode: the ECU sync pulse triggers sensors to transmit in time slots. Asynchronous mode: the sensor's own timer triggers transmission.
fsm_hints.rule: Each telegram is Manchester-coded and protected by a 2-bit/3-bit CRC or parity; the ECU discards telegrams that fail the check.

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up the sensor draws its quiescent current from the two-wire loop. In synchronous mode it then waits for the ECU sync pulse and transmits in its assigned time slot; in asynchronous mode it begins transmitting autonomously.

configurations.name: Synchronous parallel bus
configurations.description: Multiple sensors on one loop; each transmits in its time slot after the sync pulse (time-division).

configurations.name: Asynchronous point-to-point
configurations.description: A single sensor transmits autonomously over a dedicated loop.

configurations.name: Daisy-chain (universal timing)
configurations.description: Sensors in a daisy chain with the PSI5 universal timing model.
